“I can confirm that earlier today U.S. forces struck two Iranian launchers on Larak Island,” Hawkins stated. “Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps forces were observed preparing to launch rockets with sea mines into the Strait of Hormuz.”

The captain stated that CENTCOM previously cleared the strait’s international shipping routes of mines. Hawkins added that American forces are “monitoring the area closely,” and “remain prepared to protect the free flow of commerce through this essential waterway.”
